text:
kiran patel: Hey everyone  Kiran here, joining Infra (IC2) today. Quick run-down: will be in CET (UTC+1). Couple of setup asks so I don't block myself:
- Is there a recommended dotfiles repo or our standard zsh/profile to pull?
- I ordered a MacBook Air (M2) but might need an HDMI dongle + external monitor. Who handles peripherals?
- Access: need read on redwood-infra org in Console and access to the staging cluster (small quota).
- Fun fact: climbed my first 5.10 route last month. :mountain:

jamie (people ops): welcome Kiran!! :tada: 
- Dotfiles: we don't enforce one; but most folks clone https://git.cool/redwood/dotfiles and then copy the zshrc. It's a good baseline.
- Peripherals: fill https://forms.redwood.example/equipment and choose "peripheral pack (monitor/dongle)". We try same-day for monitors if office stock exists.
- Console & cluster: confirm the org slug you need (likely "redwood-infra"). I'll open the IAM request and add you to the onboarding doc.

henry (devex): Hi Kiran  I'm your buddy. Quick checklist: 
- Add SSH pubkey at https://id.redwood.example/account/ssh-keys
- Test jump host: `ssh kiran@jump.redwood.com`
- For staging cluster, we usually tag requests with the team name and quota size. If you paste the form ID here I'll create the ticket.

sora (security): Hey  a couple security notes: enable 2FA on SSO, register your device serial on the equipment form when it arrives, and don't forget to enroll MDM.

mdm-bot: Enrollment pending for kiran.patel@example.com. Device: MacBookAir (arm64). Status: awaiting user action to select image.

kiran patel: Thanks! I'll pick the arm64 image and enroll now. Org slug is "redwood-infra". Filled equipment form (put "monitor + HDMI" in notes). Also will clone the dotfiles repo and ping you Henry if I hit SSH issues.

henry (devex): sweet  ping when on VPN, we can screenshare and confirm Console perms + cluster access. Also pro tip: if your terminal font looks weird, try `brew install font-jetbrains-mono` ;)
